summary: fix(settings): send originalLoginEmail on inline recovery key reauth
description:
Because:

* After the errno 120 retry, inline recovery key setup reauthed with the signup email and no originalLoginEmail, so /session/reauth returned errno 142.

This commit:

* Adds an optional originalLoginEmail to the authPW reauth credentials in recovery-key.ts.
* Passes the stored account email from InlineRecoveryKeySetup when it differs from emailForAuth.
* Adds unit tests for both cases.

Closes FXA-15105
